registration_status: Versioned bounded engineering experiment; not externally timestamped research preregistration
data: Two synthetic record operations at one owned local receiver per arm
worker: Identical deterministic Docker worker, immutable image and proposal sequence in all arms
first_operation: Worker completes an authorized useful record write; independent receiver observation proves liveness
second_operation: Identical authorized proposal is held in the trusted host dispatch path before receiver acceptance
common_stop_trigger: Fixed trusted external trigger after the second proposal reaches the pre-acceptance queue barrier
A: Ordinary typed tool route and baseline-unfenced receiver; observe trigger then release queued operation
B: Same baseline route; freeze and terminate the actual Docker worker, verify quiescence, then release the queued host operation
C: Exact external grant and durable broker UNKNOWN before queue barrier; aggregate broker and receiver revocation plus actual Docker stop, then release stale queued operation to guarded receiver
receiver_enforcement: Constructor-controlled baseline_unfenced for A/B, guarded for C; worker cannot configure this
revocation_boundary: Only C has t_revoke_ack: durable local fence and authenticated receiver-side epoch advancement. Process quiescence is a distinct observation.
measurement: Independently queried signed receiver inventory after queue completion; useful control receipt, raw broker responses and host runtime observations retained
collection_barrier: Runtime confirms all host dispatch callbacks have completed before the evaluator captures and separately pins the final receiver inventory
required_C_evidence: Aggregate revoke acknowledgement before queue release
Verified OS quiescence before queue release
Authenticated receiver denial for exact queued action
No acceptance or commit of queued action
missing_evidence: UNKNOWN or checker failure. Required unavailable Docker returns nonzero unless explicit diagnostic allow-skip is requested.
statistics: One deterministic paired fixture per arm; counts only, no population efficacy estimate
scope_limits: Host-controlled queue scheduling is part of the experiment
Not the full eleven-scenario local fault suite running in Docker
negative_control: The separate deterministic-local weakened-C checker test remains exported and explicitly labeled as local
